_about: How the pathfinder prices a trip before traffic exists. Road segments take their free-flow speed from their type in roads.json. Rail and path segments have no types until M7 and M8, so each network gets one speed here, in km/h. Both are placeholders with no source, there only so a route filtered to rail or path has a cost. M5 replaces free-flow time with congested time.

rail.source: Placeholder. A rough average for urban rail with stops, until M7 gives rail its own types.

path.source: Placeholder. Walking pace, until M8 gives paths their own types.
